remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST ON MONDAY 11/17 AT 3:00. Welcome to this charming 1 bedroom condo perfectly situated in desirable Glenbrook. This cozy condo offers abundant natural light, updated kitchen and bath. It is located far away from Courtland Ave so you won't hear any traffic noise and it is an end unit. There is also a patio with sliders perfect for morning coffee or relaxing evenings. Enjoy the convenience of 2 parking spots, common laundry in the building next door, and a large storage locker that is as big as a walk-in closet.Heat and hot water are included in the common charges. It is ideal for first time homebuyers or downsizers. Don't miss this opportunity to live in vibrant Stamford. Close to I95, Cove Island Beach, train station, downtown Stamford, Darien, shopping and restaurants. Move-in ready!
